title: Lesson 44 adverbial nuclear clauses technical proof

groups.title: Adverbial nuclear domain and degree system
groups.proposal: Use the canonical adverbial-potential gate and subject operation to distinguish first- and second-degree adverbial nuclear clauses.
groups.readingJob: Show Source clause kind, licensed degree, source state, and subject-operation effect.
groups.decisionSplit: Degree is selectable only when the exact Source licenses more than one degree.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not treat every NNC or VNC as automatically adverbial.

groups.title: Lexicalized VNC adverbials
groups.proposal: Admit only owner-recognized lexicalized VNC adverbial Sources and preserve their typed contrasts, collocations, and written boundaries.
groups.readingJob: Show lexical potential, degree restriction, state slots, collocational requirements, and negative contrasts.
groups.decisionSplit: Only an owner-issued surface variant or required collocation becomes selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize from a similar-looking VNC or from an English adverb gloss.

groups.title: Absolutive and possessive NNC degree formations
groups.proposal: Build first- and second-degree adverbial clauses from exact NNC Source state, with second-degree sounded num1 becoming silent only through the canonical subject operation.
groups.readingJob: Show absolutive or possessive Source state, number-slot behavior, derived distributions, and function ambiguity.
groups.decisionSplit: Degree is a genuine choice only for Sources whose potential frame licenses both values.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not erase number material by string manipulation.

groups.title: Particle-looking NNC system
groups.proposal: Keep nel, huel, nēn, mō, cuēl, mach, and quēn inside their typed adverbial NNC records while composing negative particles, rhetorical force, fused in, and sentence position through contextual axes.
groups.readingJob: Show lexical status, polarity, negation scope, question force, position, collocation, and homophone boundaries.
groups.decisionSplit: Only context values explicitly licensed by the selected Source are available.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not classify these Sources as particles merely from their surface appearance.

groups.title: Other absolutive adverbial Sources
groups.proposal: Route the licensed time, duration, place, manner, degree, stress-group, and uncertain-collocation records through the common adverbial potential gate.
groups.readingJob: Show semantic domain, lexical status, stress partner, boundary behavior, and uncertainty without storing targets.
groups.decisionSplit: Stress or contextual partners are selectable only when the Source record licenses them.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not use the lexical inventory as a whitelist against productive owner-issued Sources.

groups.title: Productive preterit-agentive adverbials
groups.proposal: Consume only exact owner-issued preterit-agentive Results for productive general-use adverbialization, preserving regular, obsolete, root-plus-ya, irregular, transitive, and reflexive source distinctions.
groups.readingJob: Show the upstream Deverbal Result, source family, restrictions, and scalar-paradigm identity.
groups.decisionSplit: Source-family alternatives remain governed by the upstream canonical owner.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct the prerequisite from raw segments or a copied Result.

groups.title: Possessive-state adverbials
groups.proposal: Preserve possessive Source state and its first-degree-only restriction while separating active-action, patientive, conjectural, and lexicalized analyses.
groups.readingJob: Show possessive state, possessor morphology, source analysis, and uncertainty separately.
groups.decisionSplit: No second-degree choice is exposed when the possessive Source forbids it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not promote conjectural or conflicting analysis into generation authority.

groups.title: External and incorporated adverbial scope
groups.proposal: Project an exact adverbial Source into the canonical nominal-embed VNC path when incorporation is licensed, discarding the external subject and recomputing the internal boundary.
groups.readingJob: Show external-versus-incorporated scope, deleted subject, retained stem, boundary changes, and compound-only restrictions.
groups.decisionSplit: Scope is selectable only when the exact Source licenses both external and incorporated uses.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not incorporate a copied surface or infer internal boundaries from spelling.
